⏱️ Safety Timer:

Perfect when going somewhere alone!

How it works:
1. Go to Timer tab
2. Set a duration (e.g., 30 minutes)
3. Tap "Start Timer"
4. Check in before time runs out

If you DON'T check in → Guardian automatically sends your location to all trusted contacts. No action needed from you!

Use it for: walking home late, meeting strangers, solo trips.

⚠️ Unsafe Area Reporting:

Go to Unsafe Areas from the menu to:
• View a live map of reported unsafe spots near you
• Report a new unsafe area (dark alleys, crime spots)
• Upvote reports to warn others

This community data is used by Safe Route to automatically avoid dangerous areas.
